Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase!
... THE RUN CHASE ...

Right then! The onus is now on the batters to chase down this stiff target and it is not going to be easy as the wicket is on the slower side. United Arab Emirates batters have done their job and it's now upon their bowlers to defend the target and get their first win of the series. Join us back in a while for Ireland's reply with the bat.

Ireland bowlers had a superb start as Josh Little provided them with an early breakthrough scalping a wicket in the first over itself. The bowlers conceded a few runs after that but got a lucky breakthrough soon after the Powerplay. The bowlers couldn't capitalize and didn't create pressure on the opposition. Chirag Suri was taking the game away from them but Craig Young got the better of him in his comeback spell. They would feel that the bowlers conceded a little too extra in the final overs. Ireland did try to attack and find the wickets but UAE batters were up to the task today. Josh Little was the pick of the lot scalping an early wicket in the first over. Craig Young and Mark Adair also got their names into the wickets column but very expensive.

United Arab Emirates will be very happy with the total! They lost an early wicket as Waseem Muhammad departed for a duck but that didn't add any pressure on them. Chirag Suri and Vriitya Aravind took on the bowlers and scored 45 runs in the first six overs making it a fruitful Powerplay for their side. The partnership was moving well but a slight mix-up saw Aravind got out. Chirag Suri and Muhammad Usman steered the ship and kept the scoreboard ticking. Suri also brought up his maiden T20I fifty. After he got out, the onus was on Usman to score the bulk of runs but he also perished in the process. But some lusty blows from Basil Hameed in the death overs helped his side put on a very challenging total on the board and will be pleased with that.

54 runs in the last 5 overs and United Arab Emirates have managed to cross 160 courtesy of Basil Hameed's powerful hitting at the end. Ireland bowlers pulled things back in the middle overs but lost their way in the death overs and will have to work hard to chase down the target.
SIX! What a way to end the innings from Basil Hameed! On middle and Hameed has smoked this one over the long on fence for another maximum. 20 off the final over and UAE FINISH WITH 163/4!
FOUR! Cheeky from Basil Hameed! A length ball, on off. Hameed makes room and scoops it over the keeper and the ball races into the third man fence.
SIX! BOOM! Full toss, on off. Basil Hameed swings freely and across the line. He nails it over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
A slower delivery, very full and on the stumps. Daud drills it down to long on for another one.
A slower short delivery, around off. Hameed thumps it down to long off for a run.
On middle and leg, Hameed flicks it on the leg side and races back for the second.
Craig Young to bowl the final over.
Full and straight, Hameed drills it back towards the bowler. The ball hits Adair and goes towards mid off. They get a run. 15 off it.
SIX! Second six of the over! A slower delivery, Basil Hameed dances down the track and smokes it over the long off fence for a huge hit.
Full toss, on the stumps. This is flicked on the leg side for a single.
Slower delivery, on top of middle, completely bamboozles the batter.
SIX! WOW! That is a shot and a half from Kashif Daud. Short ball, on middle. Daud hangs back and muscles it over the square leg fence for a biggie.
Mark Adair to bowl the penultimate over.
A yorker length delivery, following the batter. Hameed digs it out to deep square leg for one.
Full and wide. Hameed follows the ball and hits it to wide long on for a run.
Outside off and Hameed cuts it behind point for a couple of runs. Excellent running again.
WIDE! Full and way too outside off. Hameed leaves it alone. Wided.
Back of a length again and sliding down leg. Hameed tucks it around the corner and picks up a couple.
Little hits the length hard, around off. Daud taps it towards point for a single.
Dropped! Back of a length, on middle. Kashif Daud short arm jabs it towards deep mid-wicket where Gareth Delany fumbles the catch. They get two.
Little bangs in a slower one and Hameed looks to pull again. The ball comes off the gloves and goes nowhere. They scamper through for a single though.
Another slower short ball. Hameed pulls it uppishly towards square leg for a single. Just 4 runs and a wicket from that over.
Fullish ball, around off. Hameed looks to heave it on the leg side but misses. The bowling side appeals as there was some noise but the umpire is unmoved.
On the pads and flicked towards deep square leg for a run.

OUT! CAUGHT! Muhammad Usman has thrown his wicket away! Back of a length and slower in pace, angled into the body. Usman makes room and swings across the line. Usman doesn't get enough on it and hits it straight down the throat of Andy Balbirnie at deep mid-wicket, who makes no mistake.
Commentary.Howout: c Andy Balbirnie b Mark Adair

Commentary.Commentary: Kashif Daud is the new batsman in.
WIDE! An attempted slower bumper, goes way over the batter's head. Wided.
Banged into the deck, around middle. Hameed mistimes his pull towards mid-wicket and gets a single.
A length ball, around off. Hameed pats it back to the bowler.
Mark Adair to operate now. His figures read 2-0-21-0 so far.
Full and straight, driven down to long on for a single.
On off and nudged towards point for a quick single.
Length again, on middle. Hameed leans in and plays an exquisite on drive for only a single.
Wide outside off and Hameed slashes it behind point for a brace.
A length ball, around off and this is tapped on the off side.
Basil Hameed is the next batsman in.

OUT! LBW! Craig Young has finally provided the breakthrough for Ireland. A length ball, on off and sliding in. Chirag Suri walks right across his stumps and looks to flick. He misses and gets rapped on the pads, plumb in front. The umpire raises his fingers and Chirag Suri has to walk back after a great half-century.
Craig Young comes back into the attack.
Slower through the air, on leg. Usman pats it back to the bowler.
Full and on middle, Chirag Suri looks to switch-hit. The ball goes off the bottom half to third man for a single. Simi Singh appeals for an LBW but the umpire is unmoved.
Loopy ball, on middle. Usman nudges it to mid-wicket for a single.
FIFTY! Flatter ball, outside off. Chirag Suri cuts it towards deep point for a single. He brings up his maiden T20I fifty. What a moment for him.
On leg, worked away to deep square leg for a run.
Full and on middle, Suri makes room and steers it to sweeper cover for a single.
Simi Singh (3-0-24-0) comes back in to finish his spell.
Full and outside off. Usman steers it to backward point. The fielder there does well to dive to his right to stop the ball. Saves a few runs for his team.
Full and on middle and leg, Muhammad Usman nudges it to deep mid-wicket. There is a misfield that allows the batters to come back for the second.
Short of a length, on off. Chirag Suri pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Short of a length on middle, pulled to deep square leg for a single.
FOUR! Length ball, outside off. Muhammad Usman stays deep in the crease and slices it past point for a boundary. 100 up for United Arab Emirates!
On a good length, on off. Suri punches it towards covers for a run.
Curtis Campher (2-0-10-0) comes back into the attack.
Floats it up, on middle. Usman pushes it back to the bowler.
Short and on leg, Suri makes room for himself and pushes it through covers for a single.
Full and on off, Usman prods and works it to mid-wicket for one.
Flatter ball, outside off. Muhammad Usman rocks back and looks to cut it away but misses.
FOUR! Nicely played! A full toss outside off, Muhammad Usman gets down on one knee and sweeps it to deep square leg for a boundary.
WIDE! Flighted delivery way too outside off, Usman leaves it untouched. Wided.
Full and on off, driven towards covers for a single.
Gareth Delany comes into bowl for the first time today.
A googly, outside off. Chirag Suri looks to drive but gets an inside edge. The ball goes to short fine leg and the batters take a single.
On the pads, worked away to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Floats it up, on off. Usman pats it back to the bowler off the back foot.
Full and outside off, slapped through covers for a single.
SIX! Loopy ball on middle, Chirag Suri dances down the track and lofts it over long off for a maximum. Lovely shot! He moves onto 42 now.

WIDE! Drifting it down the leg side, Chirag Suri charges down the track and looks to work it on the leg side but misses. The keeper whips the bails off but Chirag Suri made it back to the crease in time.
Loopy ball, on off. Usman eases it to long off for a single.

DRINKS! After the early wicket, United Arab Emirates have made a comeback in this match. Chirag Suri and Vriitya Aravind steered the ship well before a mix-up led to Aravind being run out. Suri and Usman have done well to keep ticking over. Josh Little has been fantastic for Ireland but needs a bit more help from the others.
Fuller in length, outside off. Chirag Suri creams it through covers for a couple of runs.
Full and on middle, Usman looks to flick but gets a leading edge to cover for a single.
Length ball, outside off. Suri taps it to point for a single.
Outside off, worked to covers.
On a length on off, Suri pushes it towards covers for a single. The fielder has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. There is no one backing up and the batters take another single off overthrows.
Good-length ball, outside off. Muhammad Usman steers it to deep point for a single.
WIDE! Length ball, down the leg side. Muhammad Usman looks to flick but misses. Wided.
The switch hit comes out now. Fullish delivery, on leg stump. Suri gets on one knee and switch hits it towards deep backward point. They get a couple.
Singh sees Suri coming down the track and fires it in on the pads. Chirag Suri looks to flick but misses and the ball goes off the pads towards square leg.
Smart batting, rotating the strike after the boundary. Fuller one, on middle and leg. Usman drills it down to long on for one.
FOUR! Flighted ball, on off. Usman stays low and crunches it over extra cover for a boundary.
Flatter one, on middle and kept out by Usman.
On middle and leg, Usman blocks it out.
Length again, on top of middle. Usman works it on the leg side for a single.
Full and around off, Usman mistimes his drive towards mid off.
A good-length ball, on off. Suri works it off the back foot towards deep mid-wicket for a single. Suri straightaway calls for 'NO.'
Back of a length, on middle. Usman taps it towards deep mid-wicket for a run.
A length ball, on off and jagging back in. Usman pats it back to the bowler.
FOUR! A short ball, not short enough. Muhammad Usman rocks back and pulls it powerfully into the mid-wicket fence. Easy pickings.
On the pads and flicked behind square on the leg side for a brace.
Quicker and flatter, angled into leg stump. Usman makes room and works it to mid-wicket. They scamper through for the run and make it in time.
Fired in on middle stump. Usman blocks it out.
On middle and turning in, Suri tucks it to square leg for a single.
Uppish but safe. Tossed up, around off. Usman eases it to long off for a run.
On the pads, Chirag Suri clips it to mid-wicket for a single.
A length ball, outside off. Usman plays and misses.

OUT! RUN OUT! There was never a two there! Suri works the full ball towards deep mid-wicket. Vriitya Aravind thinks they'll push for two again and sets off without even looking at his partner. Aravind is stranded halfway down the pitch and the throw from Mark Adair is a good one. Ireland get a lucky breakthrough. Muhammad Usman walks out to bat.
Full and straight, flicked through mid-wicket for a couple. Good running.
A slower one, deceives the batter. Suri looks to flick it on the leg side but gets a slight leading edge back onto the deck.
Good-length, around off. Suri taps it to point.
Curtis Campher comes into the attack.
On off and oushed towards mid off.

FOUR! Third boundary in the over for Vriitya Aravind. Slower one, well outside off. Aravind picks it up and lifts it over point for yet another boundary. 16 off it and UAE are 45/1 at the end of the Powerplay.
A shortish ball, angled into the body. Suri tucks it behind square on the leg side for a single.
WIDE! Adair bangs it in short, a bit too short according to the umpire. Wided.
Full, on off and driven firmly to mid off for a quick single.
FOUR! And again, even better. In the slot and Aravind hammers it back over the bowler's head for another boundary.
FOUR! Up and over from Vriitya Aravind. A juicy half-volley, around off. Aravind gets low and smokes this over extra cover and the ball races into the fence.
A length ball, around off, nicely guided to third man by Suri for a single.
Length ball, on middle. Vriitya Aravind heaves it to deep mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
A low full toss on middle, flicked to deep square leg for a single.
Full again, on middle. Vriitya Aravind whips it through mid-wicket. The fielder from deep square leg runs to his left to stop the ball. The batters pick three runs. Good running between the wickets.
Full and on middle, Suri flicks it to deep square leg for a single.
Fullish, on middle. Vriitya Aravind drills it to mid on. The fielder there misfields and allows the batters to take a single.
Short of a length, outside off. Chirag Suri looks to defend but misses. The ball goes off the outside edge to third man for one.
Craig Young comes in from the opposite end now.

Good-length ball, outside off. The ball shoots up after hitting the deck. Vriitya Aravind is taken aback by the bounce and leaves it alone. A good over from Mark Adair despite getting hit for a boundary off the first ball. Just 5 runs from it.
Length ball, outside off. Vriitya Aravind looks to paddle scoop it but fails to connect.
On a length, on off. Aravind taps it towards covers.
Full and on leg, Suri flicks it to deep square leg for a single.

On middle, nudged to mid-wicket. Suri looks for a quick single but is sent back by Vriitya Aravind. Paul Stirling collects the ball and scores a direct hit at the striker's end but Chirag Suri was inside the crease.
FOUR! What a shot! Full and outside off, swinging away. Chirag Suri lunges forward and drives it through covers for a boundary.
Mark Adair comes into the attack now.
Short of a length, on off. Aravind hops and taps it towards point.
FOUR! Vriitya Aravind opens his account with a boundary. Short of a length on leg, Vriitya Aravind looks to pull. The ball goes off his gloves to fine leg for a boundary.
Full and on off, Vriitya Aravind looks to drive but gets an inside edge. The ball goes to short fine leg.
Length ball, outside off. Chirag Suri guides it to third man for a single.
Good-length ball, on off. Suri punches it towards covers.
JAFFA! Good-length ball, in the fifth stump channel, angling away. Chirag Suri looks to defend but misses. The ball whizzes past the outside edge and carries through to the keeper.
Tap and run! Length ball, on off. Chirag Suri taps it towards covers and scampers across for a quick single.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! Short of a length, outside off. Chirag Suri slices it towards third man for another boundary. He is looking good and confident.
FOUR! Lovely shot! Full and outside off, Chirag Suri leans onto it and drives it through cover-point for a boundary.
Extra bounce on that one! Length ball, outside off, nipping away. Chirag Suri shoulders arms and lets it sail through.
Good-length ball, outside off. Chirag Suri looks to push it on the off side but misses. The ball zips past the outside edge.
Good-length ball, on off. Chirag Suri punches it to point.
Who will bowl from the other end? It's going to be Craig Young.
Good-length ball, outside off. Vriitya Aravind slaps it but straight to point. Top over from Josh Little. A wicket and a single from it.
Fuller in length, on middle and leg. Vriitya Aravind looks to flick but misses. He gets hit on the pads. Josh Little seems very confident and pleads for an LBW but the umpire shakes his head.
Vriitya Aravind is in at number 3.

OUT! TAKEN! Josh Little draws first blood. Josh Little bowls it full and on leg, Waseem Muhammad flicks it but straight to the fielder at square leg. Mark Adair there doesn't have to move an inch and takes the catch easily. Waseem Muhammad walks back to the pavilion for a duck. A superb start from Ireland.
Commentary.Howout: c Mark Adair b Josh Little

Commentary.Commentary: Full and wide outside off, Waseem Muhammad defends it towards covers.
Length ball, outside off. Waseem Muhammad punches it towards covers off the back foot.

Little starts with an inswinger, on middle. Suri looks to defend but gets an inside edge onto the pads. The ball rolls to short third man and the batters get a single. United Arab Emirates and Chirag Suri are up and running!

We are all set to begin! Ireland players stride out to the middle. Chirag Suri and Waseem Muhammad are the openers for United Arab Emirates. Josh Little to start the proceedings with the ball. Here we go...

United Arab Emirates (Playing XI) - Waseem Muhammad, Chirag Suri, Karthik Meiyappan (In for Sanchit Sharma), Vriitya Aravind (WK), Muhammad Usman, Akif Raja (In for Rohan Mustafa), Kashif Daud, Ahmed Raza (c), Basil Hameed, Alishan Sharafu (In for Chundangapoyil Rizwan), Zahoor Khan.

Ireland (Playing XI) - Paul Stirling, Kevin O'Brien (C), Andy Balbirnie, Gareth Delany, George Dockrell, Neil Rock (WK), Curtis Campher, Craig Young (In place of Benjamin White), Josh Little, Mark Adair, Simi Singh.
TOSS - Ireland have won the toss and they have elected to field first.

Hello and a warm welcome to the third T20I of the UAE Summer T20 Bash where United Arab Emirates are up against Ireland. United Arab Emirates lost the opening fixture against Namibia and then lost to Ireland on Thursday. Not having enough runs to play with was the main reason for their downfall and they would want to change that and put up a strong fight in this match. Ireland on the other hand are coming after a win and will be high on confidence. They are preparing themselves for the upcoming T20 World Cup, and they can't get a better platform than this to keep themselves ready. They would look to get another win here. Will United Arab Emirates get their first win? Or will Ireland dominate again? We will find out. Stay tuned for further updates.
